node.title: Rank-eleven component stars force a large owner, pencil, or kernel plane
node.closure: recordwise incidence amplification, ten-subset star averaging, and evaluation-rank owner-pencil classification
node.statement: At least 540546700 parts per billion of the non-dense records in an unsafe residual, at least 148639925144138894 records, have 98 percent of their eleven-subsets on components. Each has a ten-subset with 98 percent component extensions. Full evaluation rank gives one affine owner whose support deficiency is at most 22320. Evaluation rank nine gives one owner pencil with direction beta*(-gamma*u,u) and at least 45153 full-rank component extensions. Rank at most eight gives a common kernel plane. These outputs remain recordwise and unaggregated.
